projects.title: Nail by Eyu / Identity
projects.short: A green-and-gold beauty identity, carried through logo variations, social formats and presentation mockups.
projects.challenge: The work brings a nail-care name into a recognisable visual system across a logo, social posts and branded applications.
projects.approach: A stylised nail symbol and star sit alongside a serif wordmark. Deep green, gold and pale-yellow variants connect the square and vertical layouts. The same identity appears on a shopping-bag mockup and a phone-icon presentation.
projects.result: The identity extends across seven pieces: two horizontal logo treatments, a square social graphic, two vertical graphics, a shopping-bag mockup and a phone-icon presentation.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The curved nail symbol creates a compact signature, while a repeated motif gives the logo backgrounds texture. The bag and phone mockups explore how the same identity reads at different scales.

projects.title: Ashenda / Festival
projects.short: Festival poster and backdrop artwork with a shared black-and-gold identity and Ethiopian decorative borders.
projects.challenge: Festival communication needs a strong event name alongside performers, venue, ticket tiers and supporting marks.
projects.approach: The poster uses a large Ashenda title, illustrated women and grouped ticket information. Black-and-gold contrast and geometric border details continue into the matching backdrop layout.
projects.result: A square promotional poster and matching backdrop layout share the Ashenda title, ornamental borders and black-and-gold palette.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The poster carries performers, venue and ticket information. The backdrop gives the festival name more space, keeping the same decorative language across both formats.

projects.title: Z-Ark / Seasonal Series
projects.short: Fasika and New Year story graphics in coordinated blue and light colour variations.
projects.challenge: Seasonal greeting graphics need to keep the message visible in a narrow story format while leaving room for expressive imagery.
projects.approach: The Fasika pair combines sculptural religious imagery with a stacked Amharic greeting. The New Year pair uses yellow flowers, a central character and white lettering. Blue and light versions retain the same compositions.
projects.result: Four vertical graphics form two coordinated pairs: blue and light versions of the Fasika greeting and the New Year composition.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The Fasika pair uses dramatic light and sculptural texture. The New Year pair combines a bright floral frame with flowing Amharic lettering, showing how the palette changes the mood of a shared composition.

projects.title: Taxi / Film Poster
projects.short: A cinematic poster study built from a portrait, a taxi and a dramatic amber landscape.
projects.challenge: A film-style poster must suggest a story through a single image while keeping the title and release message distinct.
projects.approach: The artwork layers a large portrait above a vehicle and road scene. Warm highlights guide the eye toward the face and the TAXI title, with a small Coming Soon message completing the composition.
projects.result: A finished portrait-format poster combines the TAXI title, dramatic portraiture, a vehicle and a road scene in a single cinematic composition.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: A warm amber palette links the face, sky and vehicle. Contrasting scales give the portrait a leading role, while the road and taxi draw the eye toward the title.

projects.title: Cloud Lounge / Events
projects.short: Two purple event graphics using performer portraits, dimensional lettering and nightlife lighting.
projects.challenge: Event artwork must place the performer, venue and occasion in a clear hierarchy within a compact vertical layout.
projects.approach: Purple and magenta light, cloud textures and bright dimensional type connect the two pieces. The artist portrait anchors one graphic; the companion composition gives the venue name and occasion more space.
projects.result: Two vertical Cloud Lounge promotional graphics connect performer-led artwork with a venue-focused event layout.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: Layered lettering, glowing highlights and clouds bring depth to the layouts. Portraits remain distinct from the supporting venue and event information.

projects.title: Rufi Review / Teasers
projects.short: A gold-toned teaser sequence with a wordmark-led announcement and two character compositions.
projects.challenge: A teaser needs to establish a recognisable name while creating anticipation with limited information.
projects.approach: The Rufi Review lettering remains the focal point across three gold-and-cream compositions. Repeated Coming Soon typography, a character holding a phone and a storefront scene provide different visual entry points.
projects.result: Three distinct teaser graphics establish the Rufi Review name through a wordmark-led announcement, a phone-holding character and a storefront scene.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: Gold lettering and repeated Coming Soon messages connect the sequence. The three compositions vary the balance of type, character and setting while keeping the same colour family.

projects.title: Music / Release Artwork
projects.short: Portrait-led announcement graphics for Veronica Adane and a separate music-release design.
projects.challenge: Music announcements need a memorable artist image with enough contrast for a title and release message.
projects.approach: The Veronica Adane design combines a large portrait, metallic Amharic lettering and a cool cinematic background. The companion release graphic uses a warmer landscape, large lettering and a portrait placed to the right.
projects.result: Two portrait-led music announcements show contrasting visual directions: a cool metallic composition and a warm landscape treatment.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The Veronica Adane graphic pairs a prominent artist portrait with dimensional Amharic lettering. The companion release design uses warm light and a landscape to frame its portrait and title.

projects.title: Saturday / Fest
projects.short: A vertical festival graphic with a performer collage, high-contrast title and compact event details.
projects.challenge: The poster brings multiple performers and practical event information into a single promotional image.
projects.approach: A large lead portrait sits above two supporting performers. Yellow SATURDAY lettering cuts across the blue-green background, while ticket, date and location information is arranged along the lower edge.
projects.result: A complete vertical Saturday Fest poster brings performer portraits, event naming, ticket information and venue details into one composition.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The yellow title creates a strong break between the portrait collage and the practical details below. The blue-green background keeps the different image layers visually connected.

projects.title: Culture / Seasonal Greetings
projects.short: Blue-toned graphics for Adwa, Gena, Timket, an Islamic holiday greeting and a motivational story.
projects.challenge: These pieces adapt distinct cultural subjects into a series with a recognisable colour palette and footer treatment.
projects.approach: Deep blue backgrounds, orange accents and patterned lower borders connect the artwork. Each composition uses a different central subject: a rider and flag, traditional games, a lantern, a harmonica and lemon, or hand-lettered encouragement.
projects.result: Five designs carry the shared visual language across four landscape greetings and a vertical motivational graphic.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: A consistent blue palette and patterned footer provide continuity, while the main image changes to suit each subject. Cultural references remain central to the message rather than becoming background decoration.

projects.title: DAT / Cultural Stories
projects.short: A selection of personal DAT Graphics posters exploring Ethiopian holidays, historical imagery and Amharic lettering.
projects.challenge: The series explores how a cultural theme can be carried by a strong image and a short message in a vertical format.
projects.approach: The selection moves between dark Meskel imagery, warm religious compositions, New Year flowers and a historical rider silhouette. Distinct colour palettes and Amharic lettering give each poster its own tone.
projects.result: Seven DAT Graphics posters form a collection of cultural and seasonal stories in varied vertical compositions.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The series uses Amharic lettering, warm religious imagery, New Year flowers, Meskel fire and a historical rider silhouette. Each subject shapes its own palette, lighting and focal point.

projects.title: DAT Graphics / Brand Study
projects.short: A monochrome DAT Graphics brand image using metallic barbed-wire forms and a restrained wordmark.
projects.challenge: A personal brand image can communicate a visual point of view through texture, contrast and the treatment of a mark.
projects.approach: The supplied vertical artwork places the DAT Graphics identity against a near-black background. Metallic wire forms frame the composition and introduce a sharp, sculptural texture.
projects.result: A vertical personal-brand image presents the DAT Graphics mark through a dark, sculptural visual treatment.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The low-key wordmark and metallic wire forms create a restrained composition. Texture and controlled highlights give the image its character without adding a dense text layer.

projects.title: Merch / Graphic Apparel
projects.short: T-shirt artwork and promotional mockups featuring Ethiopian history, popular culture and portrait graphics.
projects.challenge: Apparel graphics need a readable central composition and a presentation that shows how the design sits on a garment.
projects.approach: The collection uses black and white T-shirt mockups, portrait collages and bold lettering. Vertical promotional layouts frame the garments with supporting background graphics and ordering messages.
projects.result: Five garment and promotional mockups present graphic apparel through black and white T-shirts, portrait artwork and cultural references.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The collection shows how a central graphic sits on a garment, alongside vertical layouts that present the merchandise. These are visual mockups of the artwork and its applications.

projects.title: Quran Learning / Promotion
projects.short: Square and vertical promotional layouts centred on a Quran image, Amharic text and warm paper textures.
projects.challenge: A learning-service promotion needs to give its headline, subject image and contact information a clear order.
projects.approach: Warm parchment tones and burgundy lettering create the shared palette. A large Quran image anchors both formats, with the square and vertical compositions adjusting the balance between text and illustration.
projects.result: A square promotional layout and a vertical adaptation share the same warm paper texture, burgundy lettering and Quran imagery.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The two formats change the balance between headline and illustration while retaining the same visual character. Contact details are grouped with the service information inside the artwork.

projects.title: Kidus Yared / Poster
projects.short: A gold-and-green portrait poster combining a traditional instrument, Amharic lettering and an ornamental frame.
projects.challenge: The poster unites a cultural subject, a large title and supporting text in a narrow composition.
projects.approach: A portrait sits inside a circular frame beneath a large traditional-instrument form. Layered gold and green tones connect the background, lettering and decorative elements.
projects.result: A complete vertical Kidus Yared poster combines portraiture, traditional-instrument imagery and large Amharic lettering.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The circular portrait frame creates a focal point within the larger instrument silhouette. Gold and green tones carry through the lettering, ornament and layered background.

projects.title: Getahun Gizaw / Visual Identity
projects.short: A portrait-and-book identity composition adapted into a square image and a wide channel banner.
projects.challenge: The identity needs to remain recognisable when moving between a square profile-style composition and a very wide banner.
projects.approach: The square design combines a portrait, book imagery, an orange circular frame and the Getahun Gizaw Official name. The wide format repeats the identity with Ethiopian-inspired border details and a dark teal field.
projects.result: A square identity composition and a wide channel-banner layout carry the Getahun Gizaw Official name through two contrasting proportions.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The portrait, open book and orange frame anchor the square composition. In the wide banner, the identity sits beside a broad text area and patterned Ethiopian-inspired borders.

projects.title: Food & Retail / Signage
projects.short: Wide-format promotional layouts for Kana Peanut Butter and Market and a soup offering.
projects.challenge: Wide signage must make a product, business name and essential contact details visible across a shallow canvas.
projects.approach: The Kana layout pairs a shopping cart with peanut-butter imagery and large bilingual lettering on yellow. The soup banner uses a burgundy-and-yellow split, a centred product image and a separate contact block.
projects.result: Two wide-format layouts present a market promotion and a soup offering through product imagery, prominent naming and compact contact information.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: The shallow format calls for a clear horizontal reading order. Product imagery supplies the focal points, while strong yellow, green and burgundy fields separate the supporting information.

projects.title: Messi / Tribute Poster
projects.short: A football tribute composition using a trophy-led portrait montage and gold lettering.
projects.challenge: A tribute poster combines several moments and a dominant subject into a single readable vertical image.
projects.approach: The artwork layers Messi portraits and football imagery around a central trophy composition. Gold accents, handwritten-style lettering and a dark background connect the different image scales.
projects.result: A vertical football tribute poster brings together a trophy-led composition, layered player portraits and gold typography.

sections.heading: Design details
sections.text: Large and small portraits create movement through the image. Gold accents and a dark background connect the different football moments into one visual tribute.
